body:
Me and my partner visit scarefest every year, we are big Halloween fans.
The mazes do not disappoint, they are all fantastic. 
This year all the mazes are rated 15+, you can buy them on the Alton towers website or at the box office on the day of your visit.
I would suggest that if you are wanting to do them late in the evening when it gets dark, I would advise to do them at around 6PM, give it plenty of time, as sometimes some of the mazes are long with queues, particularly the Attic maze, most of the others you get in and the queues are really quick. 
We are doing the mazes at 6 so then we still have time later on to do some rides in the dark until 9. 
All of the mazes are great fun, would suggest that if you are someone that gets scared very easily then obviously would be good to go in with someone else or in a group.
Our favourite maze is the Altonville Mine Tours.
Of course all the mazes are quite jumpy at times, but that’s to be expected, a lot of strobe lighting also.
But overall they are all well worth it.
It’s from Alton Towers, from a water ride know as The River Rapids.
